nom: RoC Retinol Correxion Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Face Serum with Hyaluronic Acid

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one describing mature dry skin, report the serum reduces lines and helps with hydration without irritation.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report mixed tolerance: some note no burning or breakouts at all, others describe a brief burning sensation that fades, and one long-term user reports sensitivity in the first two weeks that diminished over time.
segments.mature: Reviewers who identify as mature or over 50/60/70 report visible softening of forehead lines, crow's feet and marionette lines with consistent use, though several with deep, decades-old wrinkles report no real change.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin found the serum too slippery/shiny for daily all-over use and preferred it only on dry areas like around the eyes.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin reports the serum did not cause breakouts or irritation despite oiliness and sensitivity.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report visible softening of fine lines, forehead lines, crow's feet and lines around the mouth within one to four weeks of regular use; several with deep marionette lines or decades-old wrinkles report no meaningful improvement even after months or a year.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe improved hydration, plumping and softer skin thanks to the hyaluronic acid; one reviewer felt it did not moisturize or fill lines as expected.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports a facial burn risk when layering with another night cream, and another describes a slight burning sensation on application that quickly faded; most others report no irritation at all.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers note the product absorbs quickly without greasiness or residue, but one cautions it can burn skin if the user is not already experienced with retinol.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the product faded brown spots in addition to helping with marionette lines; this is not otherwise discussed.
concerns.blemishes: Two reviewers report new breakouts on the forehead after starting the product, while others, including one with acne-prone skin, report no breakouts at all.
concerns.oiliness: Not substantially discussed by reviewers beyond one acne-prone reviewer noting no change in oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Tube rolls up to reduce waste
Leaves skin feeling tighter and smoother
Slippery or shiny finish under makeup

extraits.titre: NOT for Older ladies with "marionette" lines around mouth !!
extraits.texte: I'm 67 & should have known better than to believe something would work on my deep Marionette Lines from my nose to my chin. There really is not a product that can help this kind of deep wrinkle. I wish the product would have approached that area in the disclosure info. I used a whole tube around my mouth only (so that took a long time). Not 1 iota of a difference. Ladies with this horrid problem need not waste $ on this so called "filler". I was a sucker for the word & I even knew better. Shame on me.

I started noticing 11 and forehead lines at 29. I've always heard that ROC was the way to go for wrinkles. I purchased a tube of this and religiously use it on my forehead, every night before bed. It has kept my premature wrinkles at bay. I've tried the ordinary's retinol serum, not only was it super drying (it's straight retinol) but I didn't notice any difference. As soon as I went back to ROC, my wrinkles were smoother. I have super sensitive, oily and acne prone skin and this hasn't bothered it at all. I've been using this product for a year and I'm on my second tube. I highly recommend this!

I started using RoC products two years ago and they do work but it takes time to see dramatic results. I have used this retinol correction anti-wrinkle serum for two years and it had reduced my forehead, lip lines, neck lines and the deep wrinkles between my eye brows quite a lot. I took close to a year of daily use to see a decrease. I'm 51 and don't go out in the sun so this has helped as well. My skin was sensitive to it within the first two weeks but that diminished over time. I highly recommend these products.

This is very slippery. I'm 50 combo skin. I think using on really dry areas like around eyes useful but other areas no. It didn't fill anything for me. I think a pore filling primer would be better. Also it's a little shiny which emphasized the 11 line on my forehead.

This cream works great. I have dry and sensitive skin, but this doesn't break me out or irritate my skin at all. I love it and how it is helping get rid of my wrinkles, but I hate the strong smell. If it wasn't for the scent, I would give this 5 stars. It is so strong and smells like perfume. I hate the smell, but the product works so well, I try to ignore it.

extraits.titre: I would but this product again. It helps reduces the lines
extraits.texte: This is an ellexcent product for maturing dry skin. It actually works to reduced lines. It does not get rid of them, it reduces them - even deep lines. Helps with hydration and I only use in the areas that it is needed. First few days I used it day and night, noticed the difference right away. Now I only use it at night. I like it to set in for a few minutes before I apply my night cream. Also a ROC product.
I tried this for a wrinkle between my eyes and along my marionette lines. it didn't work at all for me. it just made me breakout on my forehead
